description: This file defines the EmploymentStatus class, a filter field used in generating reports related to employee employment statuses within the OrangeHRM system. It implements methods for adding query conditions based on employment status, retrieving entity aliases, and converting employment status data into an array format.

classes.name: EmploymentStatus
classes.description: A filter field class that allows filtering report data based on employee employment status, providing methods to modify query builders and retrieve status information.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Modifies the query builder to add a condition filtering employees by employment status when the operator is 'EQUAL' and an X value is set.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the list of entity aliases used in the query, specifically 'employee'.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the employment status entity retrieved via the service into an array with 'id' and 'label' for use in report display.
